comparison_against_known_passing_model.finding: Known passing topology connects hover constants into motor*_hover_sum.u2 and connects only motor*_hover_sum.y into actuator*.u. It does not also connect hover_u*.y directly to actuator*.u.
comparison_against_known_passing_model.iso04_difference: Iso04 extended Iso03, so each actuator input inherited hover_u*.y -> actuator*.u and then gained motor*_hover_sum.y -> actuator*.u, creating two sources per actuator input.

dependency_notes: A first Iso05 check failed only because QuadrotorModel was not loaded in the fresh Sysplorer session; it was not counted as topology evidence.

A first Iso06 check failed only because AWFF_LinearMPCOuterLoopControllerEquation_Sysblock was not loaded in the fresh Sysplorer session; the project-owned controller file was loaded before recording Iso06.

refined_boundary.error_6140_cause: Iso04's 6140 redundant Real equations are attributable to the duplicate actuator input connection topology introduced by extending Iso03 and then adding motor*_hover_sum.y -> actuator*.u without removing the inherited hover_u*.y -> actuator*.u direct connections.
refined_boundary.remaining_failure_boundary: After fixing the duplicate actuator input topology, Iso06 still fails with SimulateModel data=false, GetVarTimes=0, and zero aliases when sensor feedback closes the controller-to-plant loop.
refined_boundary.minimal_passing_counterexample: Iso07 passes with clean actuator sum topology and controller output driving actuators when controller feedback is trace-derived/open rather than sensor-closed.
refined_boundary.next_step: Isolate sensor feedback closure: add position feedback, angle feedback, and yaw feedback one group at a time on top of Iso07 or compare initial/frame constraints against Example1.
